message.content: {"note_claim": "Blue Origin's New Glenn exploded in May 2026, suspending operations until late 2026 at earliest, so no recent launches or booster landings occurred.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Blue Origin continues to analyze the explosion of its New Glenn rocket a little more than a month ago, but on Tuesday, CEO Dave Limp shared the company’s plan for resuming pad operations later this year.", "reason": "The page confirms a New Glenn explosion about a month before June 30, 2026, with launches expected to resume by the end of calendar year 2026, matching the note's claim of suspended operations."}

parsed.note_claim: Blue Origin's New Glenn exploded in May 2026, suspending operations until late 2026 at earliest, so no recent launches or booster landings occurred.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Blue Origin continues to analyze the explosion of its New Glenn rocket a little more than a month ago, but on Tuesday, CEO Dave Limp shared the company’s plan for resuming pad operations later this year.
parsed.reason: The page confirms a New Glenn explosion about a month before June 30, 2026, with launches expected to resume by the end of calendar year 2026, matching the note's claim of suspended operations.
